snippet.title: Bar After Bar - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Bar After Bar is a co-op game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?

Steam page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4596010/Bar_After_Bar/
